caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher rendered in shades of gray on a plain, light background. The jug has a bulbous body with a textured diamond pattern in the central section, flanked by two bands of vertical grooves—one near the base and one at the top under the neck. The neck is narrower and flares outward, ending in a wide pouring spout. The handle, attached to the left side, is large, rounded, and features a decorative double-scroll at the base where it attaches to the jug. There are no other objects or backgrounds elements in the drawing, and the composition centers the pitcher in the visual field.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
